newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt fails on jobs -- Democrats.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt fails on jobs -- Democrats.

text.p: The Australian Democrats said on Thursday the government's budget strategy had failed to deliver jobs growth at a rate which would reduce unemployment.
"More people are looking for jobs and they are not finding them," Democrats leader Cheryl Kernot said in a statement.

"It's time the government recognised its budget strategy of large-scale indiscriminate cuts has damaged confidence not restored it, and is holding the nation back rather than helping it," Kernot said.
The seasonally adjusted estimate of the number of employed people rose 25,500 in October to 8.37 million, against 8.35 million in September, the Bureau of Statistics said.
The seasonally adjusted unemployment rate rose to 8.8 percent in October from 8.7 percent in September, compared with 8.6 percent in October 1995.
